description: The public data service of IMGW-PIB, the Polish Institute of Meteorology and Water Management, publishes hydrological and meteorological observations for Poland as files and through an API. The file archive holds daily hydrological data from 1951 to 2025 organised by hydrological year, which runs from 1 November, with daily, monthly and half-yearly files of water stage, discharge and water temperature per station, a station list and change log, plus meteorological and actinometric archives, yearbooks and bulletins. The API returns current synoptic, hydrological and meteorological readings and meteorological and hydrological warnings in JSON, XML, CSV or HTML, by station id or name. Data are free public sector information reusable under the Polish Open Data Act, on condition that IMGW-PIB is named as source and processing is disclosed; other data can be requested with a reuse form. Caveats: the rules warn of legal liability when attribution is missing, file formats use comma separators with Polish headers, older file access moved during a site change, and station coverage per year must be checked in the content maps. Simulation uses: discharge and water level series for flood frequency, reservoir and dam operation, drought and low flows for water supply and irrigation, hydrological warnings for emergency response, and climate trend analysis. Related record: the ISOK Hydroportal flood maps (data-poland-isok-hydroportal-flood-hazard-risk-maps) give flood extents that these series help calibrate.
